regions.full_page: Mrs. Brigid Ronan - 68 - of 356 W. 25th, N.Y., City - Enrolled here Sept. 6 - with 50c for Poor Souls - for what seems very threatening cancer - lost her left breast five years ago. Now causing much trouble. They fear another operation ... Enrolls PP. Souls again promising more frequent Communion.
